b1-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Train to the Balaton
b1-08-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg how you get to Lake Balaton on Saturday. You (Meg) have checked the timetable: the train leaves at three and goes without a transfer.
b1-08-01.prompt: Tell Károly when the train leaves according to the timetable and that you can travel to the Balaton without a transfer.
cues: Say when the train leaves according to the timetable
Say that you can travel without a transfer
Say which way the train goes
b1-08-01.target: A menetrend szerint a vonat háromkor indul. Átszállás nélkül utazhatunk a Balaton felé.
b1-08-01.english: According to the timetable, the train leaves at three. We can travel towards Lake Balaton without a transfer.
b1-08-01.canDo: I can navigate public transport schedules, transfers, and destinations.

b1-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Road to the Lake
b1-08-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg which way the road to the lake leads. You (Meg) say that the road leads through a long tunnel and that you cross the bridge on foot.
b1-08-02.prompt: Tell Petra how the road leads to the lake and how you cross the bridge.
cues: Say what the road leads through
Say how you cross the bridge
b1-08-02.target: Az út egy hosszú alagúton keresztül vezet. A hídon gyalog kelünk át.
b1-08-02.english: The road leads through a long tunnel. We cross the bridge on foot.
b1-08-02.canDo: I can describe moving through geographical terrain, tunnels, and passes.

b1-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: As Far as the Balaton
b1-08-03.scenario: Anna asks Meg how far you travel by train on Saturday and how long the trip lasts. You (Meg) say that you travel as far as Lake Balaton and that the trip lasts until the evening.
b1-08-03.prompt: Tell Anna how far you travel and until when the trip lasts.
cues: Say how far you travel by train
Say until when the trip lasts
b1-08-03.target: A Balatonig utazunk vonattal. Az út estig tart.
b1-08-03.english: We travel by train as far as Lake Balaton. The trip lasts until the evening.
b1-08-03.canDo: I can use the terminative case -ig to specify destinations and time limits.

b1-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Late Train
b1-08-04.scenario: Petra phones Meg and asks why you are late. You (Meg) say that because of the delay you missed the train and that a replacement bus will come.
b1-08-04.prompt: Tell Petra why you are late and what is coming instead of the train.
cues: Say why you missed the train
Say what is coming instead of the train
b1-08-04.target: A késés miatt lekéstük a vonatot. Pótlóbusz fog jönni.
b1-08-04.english: Because of the delay, we missed the train. A replacement bus is going to come.
b1-08-04.canDo: I can handle unexpected travel disruptions, missed trains, and delays.

b1-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Planning the Trip to Eger
b1-08-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the weekend trip to Eger. You (Meg) have already booked the accommodation, and according to the itinerary you spend three days there.
b1-08-05.prompt: Tell Károly that you have booked the accommodation and how many days you spend in Eger.
cues: Say that you booked the accommodation
Say how many days you spend in Eger according to the itinerary
b1-08-05.target: Már foglaltam szállást Egerben. Az útiterv szerint három napot töltünk ott.
b1-08-05.english: I have already booked accommodation in Eger. According to the itinerary, we spend three days there.
b1-08-05.canDo: I can prepare a full travel itinerary, reserve accommodation, and select sights.

b1-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting to Eger
b1-08-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg how you get to Eger on Saturday. You (Meg) say that the train goes without a transfer and that you looked at the timetable on the internet.
b1-08-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the train goes without a transfer and what you looked at on the internet.
cues: Say what you looked at on the internet
b1-08-consolidation.target: A vonat átszállás nélkül megy Eger felé. Néztem a menetrendet az interneten.
b1-08-consolidation.english: The train goes towards Eger without a transfer. I looked at the timetable on the internet.
b1-08-consolidation.canDo: I can navigate Hungarian public transit, timetables, and ticket inspections.
